query_normalized: the impact of interoceptive awareness on emotional regulation during simulated stress psychology
rationale: The paper focuses on engineering fine-grained emotion intensity control in text-to-speech systems using large language models, which is an off-domain application of "emotion" to speech synthesis rather than a study of the psychological mechanism of interoceptive awareness or emotional regulation in humans.
